tested.environment: local dev server on port 5173, seeded demo account, Chromium; desktop 1280x800 and phone 390x844; light and dark

flow.given: Settings is open and the theme is Light
flow.when: the person picks Dark in the Appearance control
flow.then: the whole app turns dark at once, with no reload, and Dark shows as selected
continues: the other Settings rows keep their values and layout

check.evidence: screenshots of Settings before and after, desktop and phone, light and dark

flow.then: the page paints dark from the first frame and Settings still shows Dark

check.evidence: screenshot of the first painted frame after reload, plus Settings after reload

flow.expect: the theme store and boot script tests pass, including the storage-blocked case

evidence: npm test -- theme: 11 passed, 0 failed (output in the PR checks)

acceptable_diffs: row divider is 1px lighter than the mockup; it uses the existing line token
control is full width below the label, as the mockup notes allow under 480px

jank.item: Text and controls fit at phone width without wrapping or clipping
Focus ring is visible on every control in both themes
No flash of the wrong theme on load or on switch
Selected state is clear without relying on colour alone

fix_log.finding: Segmented control labels wrap to two lines at 390px wide
fix_log.cause: each segment had a fixed min-width of 120px, wider than a third of the phone row

fix_log.finding: Focus ring invisible on the selected segment in dark
fix_log.cause: the ring used the accent colour, the same as the selected fill in dark

assumed: Firefox and Safari paint the boot script the same way as Chromium; only Chromium was driven
surprises: Private windows in one browser throw on any storage read, which crashed the boot script until the review fix
The selected segment and the focus ring shared one colour in dark, so keyboard users lost their place
